end.summary:
Named earthworm, ant, and millipede as soil animals; also identified a damp soil spot.
Explained that roots need air and water, and earthworm tunnels help provide them.
Initially grouped earthworms with insects and other creepy-crawlies; later corrected this using the six-legs feature.
Stated that earthworms harm crops and should be removed; this idea was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming animals in soil and discussing how earthworm tunnels help air and water reach roots. Pihu used the six-legs rule to correct the mix-up that earthworms are insects. The idea that earthworms damage crops remained, so at home you can look at a picture of an earthworm and repeat: “Earthworms help soil by making tunnels and turning dead leaves into rich soil.”
